stepExplanation:
Converting units:
- Q₁ = 4 μC = 4 × 10⁻⁶ C
- Q₂ = 6 μC = 6 × 10⁻⁶ C (use magnitude)
- r = 30 cm = 0.30 m

Applying Coulomb's Law:
$$F = \frac{kQ_1Q_2}{r^2} = \frac{(9 \times 10^9)(4 \times 10^{-6})(6 \times 10^{-6})}{(0.30)^2}$$
$$F = \frac{(9 \times 10^9)(24 \times 10^{-12})}{0.09}$$
$$F = \frac{0.216}{0.09} = 2.4 \text{ N}$$
stepBody: Convert the charges to coulombs and distance to metres, then apply Coulomb's Law. Give your answer in newtons.
